name: ExtendedTimeboxTriggerCodesforPublicHealthReporting
title: Extended-Timebox Trigger Codes for Public Health Reporting
description: Composite trigger code grouping for the extended-timebox carve-out. Contains laboratory observation test names for the conditions whose lab effective-date timebox extends from the standard 30 days to 365 days (slow-manifesting or long-latency lab evidence). Composition is the union of the per-condition Lab Obs Test Name (S4) value sets for the listed SNOMED condition codes. Membership only controls timebox duration — the negative-value exclusion filter still applies to this branch. Source: ETI-DRAFT eRSD Optimization II Timing Filter Survey Results, Appendix A (76 SNOMED codes across 72 conditions; the Birth Defects category row is omitted — it represents 58 conditions that do not have S4 Lab Obs Test Name mappings and thus cannot contribute to a lab-side composite; jurisdictional birth-defect reporting flows through other channels).
purpose: Laboratory test names whose observations are reportable within a 365-day window rather than the standard 30 days. Used by eCR PlanDefinitions to route selected lab results through an extended-timebox branch.
